payout_quote: A fee of $1.99 will be automatically deducted from your earnings when you cash out. Most delivery partners will receive their earnings in 30 minutes or less, but this may vary slightly depending on your bank. As many times as you want! There is no limit to the amount of times you cash out each day.
timing: Unlimited cashouts per day, including weekends and holidays; most arrive within 30 minutes. Maximum $5,000 per day. Remaining balance pays out on the normal Tuesday weekly cycle.
eligibility: Delivery partner with a Gopuff Stripe account, no wage garnishments, at least one delivery completed, a Stripe instant-eligible debit card as payout method, and at least $1.99 in available balance.
steps: Set up your Stripe account for Gopuff and add a Stripe instant-eligible debit card as payout method.
Open the Earnings page in the Gopuff Driver app and tap the Cash Out button.
Earnings arrive (most within 30 minutes); $1.99 is deducted automatically per cashout.
catches: $1.99 fee deducted automatically per cashout, with no daily limit on the number of cashouts.

biggest_catch: Cashouts are unlimited at $1.99 each, which makes fee-bleed easy: ten cashouts in a week costs $19.90 for money the free Tuesday payout would have delivered.

who_pays: GoPuff pays your delivery-partner earnings through your Gopuff Stripe account, and Cash Out sends them to the Stripe instant-eligible debit card you added. It is your delivery pay from GoPuff - Stripe is just the payment rail.
who_qualifies: You need an active Gopuff Stripe account, a Stripe instant-eligible debit card as your payout method, at least one completed delivery, no wage garnishments, and at least $1.99 in available balance. GoPuff's official requirements also include being 21 or older, holding a valid US driver's license, having a vehicle and car insurance in your name, and passing a background check.
work_available: Delivery offers depend on demand near your facility - you pick up from a central GoPuff facility and deliver in a zone, so slow periods mean fewer offers. The official pay page promises no minimum work; your volume depends on your market.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid for deliveries you complete through the Driver app; canceled or incomplete trips do not pay. GoPuff publishes no exact rating threshold tied to cashouts on the official Getting Paid page - that part is unverified.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Each Cash Out costs $1.99, automatically deducted, and there is no limit on how many you can tap - so fees can stack fast (ten cashouts in a week is $19.90). Fuel, maintenance, insurance, and tolls all come out of your pocket, and time spent waiting at the facility or for offers, plus onboarding and the alcohol-delivery course where applicable, is unpaid: only completed deliveries pay.
when_cash_arrives: Tap Cash Out on the Earnings page anytime - including weekends and holidays - and most partners get their money within 30 minutes, at $1.99 per cashout with a $5,000 daily cap. Anything you do not cash out pays on the normal Tuesday weekly cycle, which can take a few days to land.
